name: hue-console
displayName: DevSnip Pro: API & Database Client, AI & Developer Toolkit
description: Free REST API client for VS Code, no account needed: send HTTP and GraphQL requests with environments, collections and cURL import. Plus a database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis and more, LLM token and cost tools, and a secret scanner.
author: Sayaib Sarkar

devsnip.apiTimeout.description: Default request timeout in milliseconds for the REST API Client. A per-request timeout set in the client overrides this.

devsnip.consoleLogCleanup.confirmBeforeD.description: Ask for confirmation before Clean Debug Logs removes every statement shown (console.log, print, System.out.println, Console.WriteLine and the like). Turn this off to remove them immediately.

devsnip.securityAudit.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files each workspace, cloud or dependency security scan reads.

devsnip.security.endpointTimeout.description: Default per-request timeout, in milliseconds, for the endpoint security scanner.

devsnip.analytics.enabled.markdownDescription: Send anonymous usage analytics (which DevSnip Pro tools are opened and used, and a once-a-day active ping, under one anonymous id per computer) to help improve the extension. No code, file contents or names, paths, keystrokes, tool input or output, URLs, credentials or personal data are ever sent. Also respects VS Code's `#telemetry.telemetryLevel#`: nothing is sent unless it is `all`. See docs/ANALYTICS.md.

devsnip.analytics.debug.markdownDescription: Log every analytics event, exactly as sent, to the **DevSnip Pro: Analytics** output channel.

devsnip.updates.notifications.markdownDescription: Show available updates in the DevSnip Pro Tools sidebar and status bar. The sidebar alert appears immediately after detection, including when VS Code auto-update is enabled. Snoozed and skipped releases stay hidden. With extensions.autoCheckUpdates off, automatic checks are disabled. DevSnip Pro: Check for Updates always works.

enumDescriptions: Check once an hour while VS Code is open.
Check at most once a day, in the background after startup.
Check at most once a week.
Never check automatically; run **DevSnip Pro: Check for Updates** instead.
devsnip.updates.checkFrequency.markdownDescription: How often DevSnip Pro checks for updates while VS Code is open. An automatic check also runs after startup. Manual mode disables automatic checks.

devsnip.updates.remindLaterHours.markdownDescription: How many hours **Remind Me Later** hides the update status bar item for.

enumDescriptions: Notify for rank-ups, unlocked rewards, milestones, finished quests, streak freezes and the weekly recap.
Notify only for rank-ups and unlocked rewards.
Never show progress notifications. The Milestones & Points page still shows everything.
devsnip.rewards.notifications.markdownDescription: Which DevSnip Pro progress notifications to show. Notifications are skipped while the **Milestones & Points** page is open, because it shows its own.

devsnip.security.activeChecks.description: Pre-enable the endpoint scanner's active checks (reflected-input probe and requests for well-known sensitive paths). They are read-only but generate extra traffic, so they are opt-in by default.

enumDescriptions: Run Maven (dependency:tree) and Gradle (a read-only dependency task) in trusted workspaces after asking once per workspace.
Run them in trusted workspaces without asking.
Never run build tools: DevSnip Pro resolves dependencies itself from POMs and build files.
devsnip.osvScanner.buildToolResolution.markdownDescription: Whether the OSV Vulnerability Scanner may run your build tools (`./mvnw`/`mvn`, `./gradlew`/`gradle`) to get the exact resolved dependency tree, including transitive dependencies from Spring Boot starters and BOMs. Build tools run the build's own code, so they never run in an untrusted workspace.

devsnip.osvScanner.downloadPoms.markdownDescription: Let the OSV Vulnerability Scanner's built-in Maven resolver download POM files from Maven Central (only coordinates are requested). When off, it uses POMs in the workspace and your local Maven repository only.

devsnip.osvScanner.buildToolTimeoutSecon.description: Time limit for one Maven or Gradle run of the OSV Vulnerability Scanner. Projects the build tool does not finish in time are resolved by the built-in resolver.

enumDescriptions: Check direct dependencies in their registries (latest release, deprecated, yanked, abandoned).
Check every dependency, including transitive ones (more registry requests).
devsnip.sca.healthChecks.markdownDescription: Which dependencies the SCA Scanner checks in their package registries for outdated, deprecated, yanked or abandoned releases. Only package names and versions are sent. Health findings are never counted as vulnerabilities.

devsnip.sca.knownExploited.markdownDescription: Mark vulnerabilities listed in CISA's [Known Exploited Vulnerabilities](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) catalog. The catalog is downloaded (cached for a day) and matched locally; nothing from your project is sent.

devsnip.sca.nvdEnrichment.markdownDescription: Look up CVSS scores in the National Vulnerability Database for CVEs that OSV publishes no severity for (only CVE ids are sent; cached for a week). Without an API key NVD allows 5 requests per 30 seconds, so at most 12 lookups run per scan; add a free key from the SCA Scanner's menu for more.

devsnip.sca.bomUpgradeSearch.markdownDescription: For Maven and Gradle dependencies whose version a parent POM or BOM controls (such as Spring Boot's), search that BOM's published releases for the lowest one that manages fixed versions. Reads `maven-metadata.xml` and BOM POMs from your local Maven repository and, when `devsnip.osvScanner.downloadPoms` allows, Maven Central.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with DevSnip Pro
walkthroughs.description: API requests, AI tools, security scans and databases, in five minutes.

steps.title: Find any tool in seconds
steps.description:
Every tool lives in the DevSnip Pro sidebar, grouped into 14 sections. Search with Ctrl/Cmd+K and star the ones you use.
[Open the Tools sidebar](command:workbench.view.extension.myActivityBar)

steps.title: Send your first API request
steps.description:
The REST API Client sends HTTP, GraphQL and WebSocket requests with environments, collections and history - without leaving the editor.
[Open the REST API Client](command:sayaib.hue-console.openGUI)

steps.title: Try the AI & LLM tools
steps.description:
Count tokens and compare model costs, build prompts, validate LLM JSON output and plan RAG pipelines. They run locally.
[Browse the AI & ML tools](command:sayaib.hue-console.aiMlHub)

steps.title: Run a security scan
steps.description:
Audit the workspace for hard-coded secrets and unsafe code, check cloud configuration and dependencies, or scan an endpoint you own.
[Open Security](command:sayaib.hue-console.securityHub)

steps.title: Connect a database
steps.description:
Paste a connection string for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB or Redis to browse and edit data and run queries.
[Open the Database Client](command:sayaib.hue-console.databaseClient)

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description:
Preview twelve appearance themes for every DevSnip Pro panel, from Dracula to Aurora, and unlock them with the points you earn.
[Choose a theme](command:sayaib.hue-console.chooseTheme)

steps.title: Track your progress
steps.description:
Earn points as you use DevSnip Pro, keep a streak and unlock milestones. Points pay for premium REST client tools.
[Open Milestones & Points](command:sayaib.hue-console.milestoneTracker)

scripts.compile: npm run clean && tsc -p ./ && npm run compile:web
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.vscode:prepublish: node scripts/write-analytics-config.js && node scripts/write-feedback-config.js && npm run compile
